methodology.consensus: FantasyCalc and Dynasty Dealer are averaged into one trade-market lens. That market lens and the DynastyProcess/FantasyPros expert lens each receive 50% when available. Missing sources do not count as zero.
methodology.team_value: All dynasty assets count, but the top lineup-sized group receives full weight, the next six assets receive 35%, and remaining depth receives 10% so elite starters matter more than unusable depth.
methodology.confidence: Higher when more sources cover a player and their normalized values agree. The disagreement field is the range between the highest and lowest normalized source score.
methodology.source_independence: FantasyCalc and Dynasty Dealer are distinct transaction-derived models but represent the same broad market signal, so they are clustered instead of double-weighted. DynastyProcess is based on FantasyPros expert consensus.

fantasycalc.basis: Values generated from completed fantasy trades.

dynastyprocess.basis: Open weekly FantasyPros ECR-derived dynasty values.

dynastydealer.basis: Values generated from real Sleeper dynasty trades with a small community adjustment.
